test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_ecr_lc_perf (k UInt32, s String, lc LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_ecr_lc_perf SELECT number % 1000, toString(number % 1000), toString(number % 1000) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 65536)(s) FROM t_ecr_lc_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 65536)(lc) FROM t_ecr_lc_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressionRatio('ZSTD', 65536)(toLowCardinality(s)) FROM t_ecr_lc_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT k, estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 65536)(s) FROM t_ecr_lc_perf GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 65536)(lc) FROM t_ecr_lc_perf GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
